components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill brand CTA for primary in-app actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.78rem 1.35rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; background: var(--brand); color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--brand); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, filter 0.22s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.045); transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.22s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: White pill with brand stroke for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.78rem 1.35rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); color: var(--brand); border: 1.5px solid var(--brand); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fff; transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.12); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Flow CTA
components.description: Tighter in-flow ghost pill used next to flow-cta.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.22); color: var(--brand-deep); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--brand-soft); border-color: rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input { font: inherit; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.28); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: #fff; border-color: rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.12); }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; padding: var(--card-pad); background: var(--card); border: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 225, 0.95); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); border-color: rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.22); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.28; color: var(--ink); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.26rem 0.62rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-loc { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 550; } .ds-card-cta { color: var(--brand); font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-cta { transform: translateX(2px); display: inline-block; }

components.css: .ds-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.35fr 0.75fr; gap: 0.85rem; align-items: center; padding: var(--hero-pad); border-radius: 18px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 88% 18%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), transparent 42%), linear-gradient(145deg, #fff7f0 0%, #ffe9da 58%, #fff4eb 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.1); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-hero-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 2.8vw, 1.95rem); font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.038em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--ink); } .ds-hero-title span { color: var(--brand); } .ds-hero-lead { margin: 0.4rem 0 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; font-size: 0.9rem; max-width: 48ch; } .ds-hero-tips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin: 0.7rem 0 0; } .ds-hero-art { display: flex; min-height: 8.5rem; } .ds-hero-panel { flex: 1; border-radius: 14px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 62% 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65), transparent 52%), linear-gradient(165deg, #ffe4d2 0%, #fff3ea 70%, #fff8f2 100%); min-height: 8.5rem; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.32rem 0.65rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); border: 1px solid rgba(253, 83, 34, 0.14); color: var(--brand-deep); font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview:
GoIndica is an Operate-mode productive app: a local indication marketplace that people work in, not a campaign they visit. The incumbent world is a warm cream/peach neighborhood shop — paper-cream canvas, peach hero washes, a single citrus-orange brand voice, Sora for display, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI — packed at auth-workspace density. Brand lives in precise details (pill CTAs, selected nav, status chips), not in full-bleed marketing color.

This file records the shipped `:root` system in `app/globals.css` and the shared shell/flow primitives. It does not invent a new identity. Page-local copies (`pedir-hero`, `admin-hero`, `emp-hero`, and sibling page heroes) currently fork the same peach language; they should converge onto the shared tokens and `flow-hero` / card / pill patterns rather than keep private hex and padding.
keyCharacteristics: Cream canvas (`--cream`) with white cards and peach hero panels
One accent: `--brand` / `--brand-deep`; semantic green/blue/red are status only
Sora for titles, Plus Jakarta Sans for body and chrome
Pill primary actions (`--radius-pill`) and 16px surface radius (`--radius`)
Sidebar + frosted topbar shell; flow-hero as the in-app page intro

rules.name: The Token Authority Rule
rules.body: New UI consumes `:root` (`--brand`, `--peach`, `--cream`, `--line`, `--radius`, `--hero-pad`, `--card-pad`). Do not introduce a parallel hex (including `#ec5e27`) when `--brand` already exists.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Chromatic action and identity are Brand. Semantic colors mark state. Peach and cream are atmosphere, not extra accents.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Sora for display and titles; Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else. Do not add a third family for a single surface.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are nearly flat at rest. Motion is a short ease (0.2–0.22s), 1–1.5px rise, and a softer/larger shadow. No hard offset shadows.

dos: Do consume `:root` tokens (`--brand`, `--cream`, `--peach`, `--radius`, `--radius-pill`, `--content-max`, `--page-pad`, `--hero-pad`, `--card-pad`) for new screens.
Do use pill Brand CTAs with the brand glow and 1–1.5px hover lift.
Do set auth pages in the sidebar + topbar shell at 72rem (84rem only when the page is already `page-wide`).
Do introduce in-app pages with `flow-hero` (peach wash, Sora title, muted lead, optional chips/art) instead of a new hero class.
Do keep cards white, hairlined, softly lifted; status in semantic chips.
donts: Don't mint a parallel orange (`#ec5e27` or marketing `--mkt-brand`) inside the auth workspace when `--brand` is the source of truth.
Don't add a second display font or replace Sora / Plus Jakarta Sans.
Don't use square or 4–8px buttons for primary actions — pills are the action shape.
Don't restore landing-scale padding or a marketing canvas (`#fdfdf1`) inside `workspace-body`.
Don't treat peach as a second brand or flood a view with `--brand` fill; Brand is the accent, cream is the room.
